title: Candidate decoding edge value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let each vertex be assigned a finite set of candidate labels in $[q]$, and let $a_0\\in[q]$ be a default label. For a vertex $v$ and a neighbor $w$ of $v$, the candidate decoding edge value is the iterated finite candidate expectation of the indicator that the edge permutation maps the target label at $w$ to the source label at $v$, using the respective candidate sets and default label.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
